title: Anchorage hero
description: A black, centred hero: a small bold caps eyebrow, a huge thin display headline in metallic silver (a left-to-right gradient that dims at both ends), a medium subtitle, and on wider screens two tall rounded product panels set side by side, the right one raised. A window-tall art slot glows behind it all from the top.
notes: art, cardLeft and cardRight are media slots; empty, they show token-coloured placeholders (a soft glow light; two bordered panels)
the art is as tall as the window on desktop (390×533 frame on phones) and sits under an overlaid header
phones hide the two panels, as the original does; best on dark themes
name: anchorage-hero
